name: locus
description: Write notes and tours whose links jump to exact code lines, PDF passages, spreadsheet ranges and past versions.
long_description: Lets Claude read a Locus workspace (code, PDFs, spreadsheets and their version history) and write markdown notes whose links open the exact spot in the Locus app. Use the "Write a tour" prompt to get a guided walkthrough of a folder or codebase.

workspace.title: Default workspace
workspace.description: The folder Claude works in when you don't name one. You can still point Claude at other folders in chat.

tools.name: workspace_overview
tools.description: Files and version history of a workspace

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read code, PDFs and spreadsheets as citable text, at any version

tools.name: search_workspace
tools.description: Find text across code, PDFs and spreadsheets

tools.name: make_reference
tools.description: Build a verified link to an exact place in a file or version

tools.name: validate_note
tools.description: Check every link in a note

tools.name: write_note
tools.description: Save a note into the workspace

tools.name: init_workspace
tools.description: Set up version history for a folder

prompts.name: write_tour
prompts.description: Write a guided tour as a Locus note
prompts.text: Write a tour of ${arguments.topic} as a Locus note.
